instruction: Update /etc/environment with an additional PATH to configure global environment variables.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because modifying /etc/environment requires root privileges and system-level write access. Similar to the Python symlink task, agents cannot modify system configuration files that affect all users without elevated permissions that are unavailable in the sandbox.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - modifying /etc/environment requires root privileges unavailable in sandbox environment
The 'infeasible' evaluator is the appropriate placeholder for tasks that cannot be completed due to permission/environmental constraints
Metadata explanation clearly documents why the task cannot be verified
No verification logic is needed since the task itself cannot be executed in the target environment
